findings.title: New option needs TypeScript 5.7+, which the project doesn't declare
findings.why: rewriteRelativeImportExtensions was added in TypeScript 5.7. package.json lists no TypeScript dependency or version floor, so an older tsc fails on the unknown option. This is the same type-check failure the commit is meant to fix.

findings.title: Plan body left as the unfilled template
findings.why: The document has only the scaffold comment and no plan content, although its status is 'active'.
